environment.description: IoT message gateway deployed in namespace 'iot-data-plane' within an Istio 1.19 mesh (strict mTLS enforced via PeerAuthentication). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with a default-deny posture. A secondary AuthorizationPolicy in 'iot-data-plane' permits inbound traffic ONLY from ServiceAccounts in the same namespace ('iot-data-plane') with principal matching 'cluster.local/ns/iot-data-plane/sa/*'. The MQTT-HTTP bridge (source of legitimate device messages) runs in a SEPARATE namespace 'iot-ingestion' with its own ServiceAccount 'mqtt-bridge-sa'. Note: the authorization policy was templated from the platform team's baseline and uses namespace-scoped source principal matching rather than explicit ServiceAccount allowlisting. Traffic from 'iot-ingestion' namespace is subject to a CUSTOM envoy filter that performs header inspection but the AuthorizationPolicy evaluation occurs BEFORE the EnvoyFilter in the filter chain. Sidecar resource limits the egress scope to './*' preventing unexpected outbound from the gateway pod.

config.envoy_filter: custom header inspection filter in iot-ingestion namespace
config.log_sink: elasticsearch-8.11 with field-level security and Kibana content-security-policy
